LifeLens adaptations: metric/forward normalization; original 47-joint skeleton and near topology/UV preservation; 38 mapped donor joints; native walking retarget; stance trajectories and sole-pad rig corrections (446 vertices), seven behavioral clips, alpha-mask/roughness material correction, and bounded source-derived LODs. No primitive body, voxel remesh, paid provider, viewer scraping or authenticated download is used.

Status: DRAFT — observer, visual and actual-device review required. This is not merge acceptance.
